feature: Preserve completed native/adaptive/provider work during checkout reconciliation
synopsis: The tracked production Swift/TypeScript sources listed in this report are cleared for engineering source inspection at their exact Git blobs. Automated content scans plus reviewer examination of flagged long literals found authored code, prompts, schemas and runtime data-handling references rather than embedded recorded app answers. This clearance permits source reconciliation, not reading resources, caches, logs or running AI-bearing previews.

criteria.evidence: Both branch source inventories scanned for recorded-response references, inline response-like content, multiline long literals, payload/fixture paths and replay handling. Flagged long literals are authored runtime instructions rather than saved generated answers.

fact_findings.finding: Source contains adaptive/session/practice/inventory state logic and runtime generated-answer cache/replay handling. Code can be read; actual cached values remain protected.
Six-hazard branch loads recorded Beacon responses from bundled content/ai/replay and labels replay state. Read loader code only, never referenced response JSON as engineering input.
Wired branch has actual native AppAttest transport source. Base64 operations encode runtime attestations/assertions; no captured owner attestation payload was disclosed by this audit.
Six-hazard branch contains a replay status label and rendering code, not an embedded recorded answer literal. Rendered output may still be protected.

recommendations: Priority staged clearance granted wherever present in exact manifests: App/AppModel.swift; Services/PrivateDataStore.swift, VaultPrivateDataStore.swift, AppAttestSession.swift, DirectorGatewayClient.swift; Rehearse/AdaptiveRehearsalView.swift and PracticeCheckView.swift; Next/SupplyInventoryView.swift and ScorecardCard.swift; six-hazard PreparationAICard/BeaconDebriefCard and associated bridge sources.
Use git show REF:PATH or git diff scoped only to listed source paths. Exact blob clearance does not automatically clear uncommitted worktree copies or unrelated Git diff resources.

Retain completed native views, typed sidecar/state, session/client and fallback work by reconciling contracts against current changes. This report makes no merge or replacement recommendation and does not certify behavioral correctness.

Explicitly exclude content/ai/replay recursively, every fixtures/ai tree, artifacts, output, generated captures, persisted app/cached Beacon values, .xcresult/build logs, transcripts, worktree archives, reports with copied responses, and source-linked replay JSON. These are protected or uncertain even if the app accepted them.

Tests, test fixtures, eval scripts, docs and README files are NOT blanket-cleared by this production-source report. Some test/eval paths intentionally load recorded provider responses; route execution stdout/stderr and attachments through reviewer capture.

All source APIs that read persisted generated plans, debriefs or task wording must preserve complete runtime context while engineering receives opaque references/cleared projections. Do not erase cached context just to make engineering views readable.
Native launches/SwiftUI previews can invoke loaders and render recorded content. Output reviewer must own such tools/session even though the underlying source is cleared.
limitations: This is artifact classification, not exhaustive code correctness/security review or semantic comparison across branches.
Clearance uses source-content scanning and targeted semantic inspection of flagged regions, not a claim every line of all410 listed files was manually reviewed.
No owner .env, keychain, app vault, persisted Beacon cache, real family data or physical device inspected.
No raw recorded answers are reproduced in this report. Existing referenced replay assets remain restricted.
next_owner: orchestrator and integration specialists for scoped source reconciliation
